description: Runs "typecheck" (TypeScript, fast), "build" (production build, slower), "design" (instant static scan for design tells: px sizes, gradient text, purple gradients, emoji or text-glyph icons, transition-all, scale(0) entrances, missing focus-visible styles, repeated icon cards, the same entrance animation on every section; plus a Copy group: avoid words, "to confirm" slots, long sentences, passive headings) or "links" (static link check over the source, no network: broken internal links, links that redirect, orphan pages, vague link text, external links missing rel, malformed URLs, pages with few internal links, forms with no action or a mailto: action). "design" scans files changed since the last save plus new files; scope "all" scans every source file. "links" always checks the whole site. Fix every reported error; fix warnings unless they are deliberate. Copy: fix avoid words; "to confirm" slots are expected in draft mode (list them for the owner); judge long sentences and passive headings. few-internal-links is a suggestion. A check may answer that it needs the project open in Xodia (open_in_xodia, for example when the monthly headless checks are used up): ask the user to open it there and do not call that kind again in this task. headless_busy means try once more in about 30 seconds. tailwind3_unsupported means the site uses Tailwind CSS 3, which Xodia does not support: tell the user to run npx @tailwindcss/upgrade in the repo and import it again (skill tailwind-upgrade guides it, no projectId needed), and do not call run_check again in this task.

scope.description: kind "design" only: "changed" (default) or "all". Ignored by the other kinds.

name: run_check
title: Run check
